# Validate inputs
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    if not (logp_with_result.ndim == 2 and logp_call_only.ndim == 2 and logp_no_call.ndim == 2):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be 2-dimensional")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape")
    if not (logp_with_result.size > 0):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
    if not (np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) and np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) and np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call))):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be finite")
    if not (np.all(logp_with_result <= 0) and np.all(logp_call_only <= 0) and np.all(logp_no_call <= 0)):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be nonpositive")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)  # t = 0, 1, ..., horizon-1
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute weighted loss for each candidate
    # Loss = -sum(weight * logp) over horizon axis
    loss_with_result = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_no_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)
    margin = L_minus - loss_with_result
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
